title: Epic Party
summary: the 24 returning players are divided into three tribes — cila, kalo, and vatu. ozzy wins exile for vatu but is sent to exile island. at tribal council, jenna is voted out 7-1 in the season's first blindside.
scoreImpact: no score impact — jenna was not drafted by any team.

title: Therapy Carousel
summary: kyle suffers an injury and is evacuated from the game on day 4. at tribal council, savannah is voted out 6-1.
scoreImpact: mom picks up 3 pts (savannah, 22nd place). benson has savannah as an alternate — no swap benefit yet since none of benson's picks have been eliminated.

title: Did You Vote For a Swap?
summary: a tribe swap shakes up the game. at tribal council, q is voted out 5-1.
scoreImpact: big episode for three teams — ellie, lil, and dad each pick up 4 pts (q, 21st place). ellie and dad jump to 4 pts total, lil also reaches 4.
